evidence.quote: the third generation of our WARP Charger (WARP3 Charger) has been available in our shop since the end of March.
The success of the new wallbox generation caught us off guard, and we simply didn’t get around to reporting it.
we’ll be presenting various versions of the WARP3 Charger, our WARP stand and the new WARP Energy Manager 2.0.
The apps for iOS and Android have been available in beta since the end of last year.
Release of Remote Access With this feature, access to the local web interface of the wallbox via the internet through my.warp-charger.com is possible.
Heute haben wir die Version 1.9 des HAT Bricks veröffentlicht. Diese ist mit einer verbesserten Stromversorgung ausgestattet
Zusätzlich haben wir ein neues Bricklet veröffentlicht: Das Industrial Dual AC In Bricklet.
